before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the provided weather data
weather = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
sc = ax.scatter(weather['temp_c'], weather['aqi'], c=weather['precip_mm'], cmap='viridis')
ax.set_xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_ylabel('AQI')
ax.set_title('Temperature vs. AQI, Colored by Precipitation')
cb = fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax)
cb.set_label('Precipitation (mm)')
fig.tight_layout()
